Used to calculate total sales volume per channel.

GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH channel_sales AS (
  SELECT
    sales_channel,
    SUM(charged_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
  WHERE group_level_id = 22
    AND sales_channel IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked_sales AS (
  SELECT
    sales_channel,
    total_sales,
    total_sales * 100.0 / SUM(total_sales) OVER() AS sales_share_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
  FROM channel_sales
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN sales_rank <= 2 THEN sales_channel ELSE 'Other Channels' END AS marketplace_group,
  SUM(total_sales) AS gross_sales,
  SUM(sales_share_pct) AS combined_share_pct
FROM ranked_sales
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gross_sales DESC;
